by
  intro f c m hf ho
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg0, he⟩ := (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hf).mp ho
  set g' : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => g (c + w) with hg'
  have hg'a : AnalyticAt ℂ g' 0 := by
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ g (c + 0) := by simpa using hg
    have h2 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => c + w) 0 := analyticAt_const.add analyticAt_id
    exact AnalyticAt.comp' h1 h2
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFe⟩ := hg'a.exists_eq_sum_add_pow_mul m
  set b : ℕ → ℂ := fun i => iteratedDeriv i g' 0 / (i.factorial : ℂ) with hb
  have hFc : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => F (z - c)) c := by
    have h1 : AnalyticAt ℂ F (c - c) := by simpa using hF
    have h2 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun z : ℂ => z - c) c := analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const
    exact AnalyticAt.comp' h1 h2
  refine ⟨fun k => b (m - 1 - k), fun z => F (z - c), hFc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hm
    have : m - 1 - (m - 1) = 0 := by omega
    simp only [this, hb]
    simpa [hg'] using hg0
  · filter_upwards [he, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz hzc
    have hw : z - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hzc
    have h1 := hFe (z - c)
    have h2 : g z = g' (z - c) := by simp [hg']
    rw [hz, h2, h1, smul_eq_mul, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, smul_eq_mul, mul_add]
    congr 1
    · rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun k => b (m - 1 - k) / (z - c) ^ (k + 1)) m]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      have hi' : i < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      have e1 : m - 1 - (m - 1 - i) = i := by omega
      have e2 : m - 1 - i + 1 + i = m := by omega
      simp only [e1, hb, smul_eq_mul]
      have e3 : (z - c) ^ m = (z - c) ^ (m - 1 - i + 1) * (z - c) ^ i := by
        rw [← pow_add, e2]
      rw [e3]
      have hp1 : (z - c) ^ (m - 1 - i + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hw
      have hp2 : (z - c) ^ i ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hw
      have hp3 : (i.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast i.factorial_ne_zero
      generalize (z - c) ^ (m - 1 - i + 1) = X at hp1 ⊢
      generalize (z - c) ^ i = Y at hp2 ⊢
      generalize (i.factorial : ℂ) = W at hp3 ⊢
      field_simp
    · have hp : (z - c) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hw
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp, one_mul]
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (m : ℕ), MeromorphicAt f c → meromorphicOrderAt f c = ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) → ∃ (A : ℕ → ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ), AnalyticAt ℂ h c ∧ (m ≠ 0 → A (m - 1) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, f z = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, A k / (z - c) ^ (k + 1)) + h z
